single.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: The proposal claims $20,000/month in overtime savings, totaling $240,000 annually. Costs include two nurses at $95,000 each ($190,000 total) plus a $35,000 placement fee, summing to $225,000 in Year-1 expenses. Subtracting total costs ($225,000) from total savings ($240,000) yields a net Year-1 savings of $15,000. This figure is significantly below the user's explicit constraint of >= $100,000 net savings. Therefore, the proposal fails the financial viability test defined by the user. Key facts: Annual overtime savings: $240,000 ($20k x 12 months); Total Year-1 costs: $225,000 ($190k salaries + $35k fees); Net Year-1 savings: $15,000.
POINTS OF NOTE: Net Year-1 savings of $15,000 is below the required $100,000 threshold.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Does the $20,000/month overtime savings figure account for all potential cost offsets, or are there additional hidden costs not listed in Table B?
